notes.title: Announcement of the new game and demo version!
notes.content:
We can finally show you our new project - TANK ZERO. This is an exciting arcade game, in a unique visual style. Create your own unique tank and fight with hordes of enemies alone or with friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917072/0d7a1601f6c00805c0117fa58298b4b915a1980a.png[/img]
Play Demo and wishlist game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325260/TANK_ZERO/

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility and controller support
notes.content:
We are pleased to inform you that Exosuit is compatible with most modern controllers, as well as Steam Deck. If you have any difficulties with it - write in comments to this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917072/b921f10165669a8073afd0bd398ba95521d95471.png[/img]

notes.title: Exosuit realise now!
notes.content:
We are glad to present you the full version of our first game - Exosuit. But we won't stop there and promise to release an update in the near future, which will expand the gameplay and levels even more! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2879300/Exosuit/
